## Scope

Global, keyboard-first, command-palette-style **floating search popover** opened via `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` from anywhere in the app. Combines a free-text input with a typed-token query language (`key:value` chips), a 6-tab filter rail, contextual hint/suggestion area, and right-side action icons (Quick Actions, Saved Searches, Clear/Close). When a query is active, the underlying outline is **live-filtered**, matches are **highlighted**, and a centered footer pill shows match count.

This phase specifies **UI, behavior, grammar, and data contracts only**. Storage adapters, full-text engine, and runtime wiring are deferred per `mem://constraints/backend-runtime-deferred`.

## Filter keyword inventory (carried forward from v1)

`date:` · `date-before:` · `date-after:` · `day-of-week:` · `changed:` · `created:` · `is:` · `has:` · `in:` · `text:` · `link:` · `highlight:` · `@user`

Standalone shortcuts: `me` · `others` · `today` · `tomorrow` · `yesterday` · `this-week` · `next-week` · `last-week` · `this-month` · `next-month` · `last-month`

Negation: prefix any term with `-`. Combination: whitespace = AND. No `OR` operator at launch (single exception: multiple `in:` filters union scopes).

## Tab → keyword map

| Tab | Icon | Default suggestion chips |
|-----|------|--------------------------|
| Scope (default) | 🌐 Globe | none — shows default hint |
| Mentions | @ AtSign | recent `@user` tokens |
| Dates | 🗓 Calendar | `date:`, `date-before:`, `date-after:`, `day-of-week:`, + quick: `today`/`tomorrow`/`yesterday`/`this\|next\|last week/month` |
| History | 🕐 History | `changed:`, `created:` |
| People | 👥 Users | `me`, `others` |
| More | ⋯ MoreHorizontal | `is:`, `has:`, `in:`, `text:`, `link:`, `highlight:` |
